description: This is a Java source file implementing the ProductPriceServiceImpl class which provides service methods for product pricing, including adding descriptions, saving or updating product prices, and deleting product prices within the SalesManager e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductPriceServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing product prices, extending generic entity service and implementing product price service interface.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a product price and updates the product price record.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product price or updates an existing one, including handling associated descriptions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product price, retrieving the latest version before deletion to avoid detached entity errors.
